In [[3643 BBY]], at [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]] assigned her [[Darth Nox|apprentice]]
to acquire the remaining weapon that would help them against Zash's nemesis, [[Darth Skotia]], an anti-cyborg weapon called the [[Cyber neutralizer]]. The Apprentice entered the facility eventually acquiring the Cyber neutralizer and executing [[Dorotsech]], the weapon's maker.

==Prelude==
Long before the [[Darth Nox|Apprentice]] had arrived on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash]] had ordered the scientist [[Dorotsech]] to develop a weapon that would help her against the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] superior, [[Darth Skotia]]. When the Apprentice arrived to Dromund Kaas in [[3643 BBY]] and after he [[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|retrieving]] one of the needed pieces to defeat Skotia, the [[Trandoshan relic]], Zash assigned him to retrieve the remaining piece which was the [[Cyber neutralizer]], develop by [[Dorotsech]], who was now imprisoned in the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord Grathan's estate]]. When traveling to the estate building, the Apprentice was warned by [[Sith officer|Imperial officers]] that Lord Grathan had orchestrated a full rebellion against the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and his forces were now surrounded by the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] loyal to the Emperor.

==Entering the estate==
On entering the estate, the Apprentice slew the sentry guards and infiltrated [[Grathan]]'s headquarters. He then left a pathway of corpses behind as he made his way through Grathan's [[Lord Grathan's forces|forces]] to reach Dorotsech. Dorotsech gave him the weapon's location and asked the Apprentice for protection as Zash had promised him. The Apprentice however killed Dorotsech not willing to leave any witnesses to the weapon's existence. Now with the weapon in his possession, he returned to Zash knowing he was ready to face Skotia.

==Aftermath==
The weapon was eventually [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|used]] by the Apprentice against Skotia, weakening him enough for the Apprentice to engage on a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with the more powerful Dark Lord, defeating and killing him.

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Lord Grathan's estate appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The mission represents the events of the [[Sith Inquisitor]] class story mission "Dismantling the Machine", where the player is sent by Lord Zash, to retrieve an anti-cyborg weapon that would help them defeat Darth Skotia.
